name: Ikenai Mai Life
source:
Main character loses parents early and lives with his sister Maika while helping each other. One day he recognizes romantic feeling towards his sister and struggles with this feeling. But soon he learns that sister loves him as well. How should he react?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角早年失去父母，与妹妹麦卡一起生活，互相帮助。有一天，他意识到对妹妹的浪漫感觉，并与这种感觉作斗争。但很快他就知道姐姐也爱他。他应该如何反应？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
